name: Kashimura Misao
source:
Misao is a classmate of Hayato’s and is a very outgoing and friendly girl whose family own a bakery. Misao is also a good baker and works part-time at the bakery. She’s also into sports and is part of the school’s volleyball team.

[Taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/18/shinsei-ni-shite-okasubekarazu-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
